✅ ② astronaut: 우주비행사 → 우주선(spacecraft) 탑승 훈련을 받은 사람 ←정답
❌ ③ aviator: 비행사 → 항공기 조종사
❌ ④ explorer: 탐험가 → 우주선 탑승 훈련의 의미를 담지 못함
det.tip: astronaut = 우주비행사. astro(별) + naut(항해자)

questions.passage: While working there, Chawla applied to become an astronaut. After tough training, she was __________ (assign) to a space mission.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 수동태: she was assigned to = 그녀는 ~에 배정되었다
det.analysis: be + p.p. 수동태 구문: 주어 she가 배정을 '받는' 대상이므로 수동태. assign → assigned
det.tip: be assigned to = ~에 배정되다. 수동태(be + 과거분사)

questions.passage: In 2003, Chawla and six other astronauts departed Earth for a 16-day mission. While __________ (land), their shuttle's wings had a problem which caused it to break apart.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 분사구문: While landing = 착륙하는 동안
det.analysis: While + V-ing 분사구문: 접속사 While 뒤에 현재분사. land → landing
det.tip: While landing = While they were landing (분사구문)

questions.passage: Kalpana Chawla was the first woman born in India to go into space. She received her first college degree in India in 1982. She then moved to the USA, where the University of Colorado granted her a doctorate in 1988. Later that year, Chawla accepted a job at NASA. While working there, Chawla applied to become an astronaut. After tough training, she was assigned to a space mission. In 2003, Chawla and six other astronauts departed Earth for a 16-day mission. While landing, their shuttle's wings had a problem which caused it to break apart. Unfortunately, no one survived. The USA, India, and NASA have given Chawla awards since her death. They have also named several things __________, including an asteroid and a hill on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그녀의 명예를 기리기 위해(in her honor) 소행성과 화성 언덕에 이름을 붙였다
det.analysis:
✅ ① in her honor: 그녀의 명예를 기려 → 상 수여와 이름 붙이기라는 추모 맥락에 적절 ←정답
❌ ② since her death: 사후에 → 시간적 부사구이지 이유/목적이 아님. 문법적으로 named와 어울리지 않음
❌ ③ for a mission: 임무를 위해 → 이름 붙이기의 목적이 임무가 아님
❌ ④ to break apart: 부서지려고 → 의미상 부적절
det.tip: in one's honor = ~의 명예를 기리며

questions.passage: Kalpana Chawla was the first woman born in India to go into space. She received her first college degree in India in 1982. She then moved to the USA, where the University of Colorado granted her a doctorate in 1988. Later that year, Chawla accepted a job at NASA. While working there, Chawla applied to become an astronaut. After tough training, she was assigned to __________. In 2003, Chawla and six other astronauts departed Earth for a 16-day mission. While landing, their shuttle's wings had a problem which caused it to break apart. Unfortunately, no one survived. The USA, India, and NASA have given Chawla awards since her death. They have also named several things in her honor, including an asteroid and a hill on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 힘든 훈련 후 우주 임무(a space mission)에 배정되었다
det.analysis:
✅ ① a space mission: 우주 임무 → 힘든 훈련 후 배정받고 16-day mission으로 이어짐 ←정답
❌ ② a college degree: 대학 학위 → 이미 1982년에 받았으므로 중복
❌ ③ a job at NASA: NASA 직업 → 이미 수락한 상태이므로 중복
❌ ④ an asteroid: 소행성 → 사후에 이름이 붙여진 대상이지 배정 대상이 아님
det.tip: After tough training → assigned to a space mission → 16-day mission
